preconditions.expression: all(c in {'c', 'h', 'e', 'f'} for c in P)
preconditions.description: String P consists only of lowercase letters 'c', 'h', 'e', and 'f'.
Length of string P is between 1 and 1,000,000 (inclusive).
Number of queries Q is between 1 and 1,000,000 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L <= R <= len(P) for query in queries for L, R in [query[2], query[3]])
preconditions.description: For each query, L and R satisfy 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ |P|.

preconditions.expression: all(a != b for query in queries for a, b in [query[0], query[1]])
preconditions.description: For each query, starting character a and ending character b are different.

preconditions.expression: all(a in {'c', 'h', 'e', 'f'} and b in {'c', 'h', 'e', 'f'} for query in queries for a, b in [query[0], query[1]])
preconditions.description: For each query, characters a and b are in {'c', 'h', 'e', 'f'}.

postconditions.description: Output contains exactly one line per query.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_lines[i].isdigit() for i in range(Q) for stdout_lines in [stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[i]) == sum(1 for s in range(L, R) for e in range(s + 1, R + 1) if P[s - 1] == a and P[e - 1] == b and P[s - 1] != P[e - 1]) for i, (a, b, L, R) in enumerate(queries) for stdout_lines in [stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: For each query (a, b, L, R), the output line is the count of substrings P[s..e] where 1 ≤ s < e ≤ |P|, L ≤ s < e ≤ R, P[s-1] == a, P[e-1] == b, and P[s-1] != P[e-1].
